header.how: Each family: records picked by Python random.Random(f'{seed}:{name}').sample, in file order. Data is base64 of raw little-endian f64 records (inputs then three's outputs). The meshes are kernel/meshes.json as dumped and kernel/meshes.bin gzipped, whole.

families.name: compose
families.what: Matrix4.compose(position, quaternion, scale), then Matrix3.getNormalMatrix of it

families.name: applyMatrix4
families.what: Vector3.applyMatrix4: half the matrices composed, half 16 random elements (w divide); half the vectors float32

families.name: setFromUnitVectors
families.what: Quaternion.setFromUnitVectors; 10% exactly opposite, 5% nearly opposite, 5% equal

families.name: setFromQuaternion
families.what: Euler.setFromQuaternion(q, order); order 0 XYZ, 1 YXZ, 2 ZYX; some quaternions at gimbal lock

families.name: color
families.what: new Color(hex) (sRGB to linear), and for a = Color(hexA), b = Color(hexB): a.clone().lerp(b, alpha), new Color().lerpColors(a, b, alpha), a.clone().multiplyScalar(s)

families.name: vector
families.what: Vector3: v.applyAxisAngle(axis, angle), v.applyEuler(e), v.normalize() (2% zero), crossVectors(v, w), v.distanceTo(w), v.dot(w), v.length(), v.lerp(w, alpha)
